name: Jewelry Invoice & Certificate Generator
author: Vimal Kava

sections.description:
Jewelry Invoice & Certificate Generator is a comprehensive solution for WooCommerce stores specializing in jewelry, gemstones, and precious metals. It automatically generates GST/VAT-compliant invoices and detailed purchase certificates, ensuring your business meets professional standards.

Key Features:
* Auto-generate professional PDF invoices for every order.
* Create detailed Purchase Certificates for jewelry items.
* GST/VAT compliant tax calculations.
* Support for hallmarks, metal purity, and weights.
* Customizable templates to match your brand.
* Multi-currency and global market support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Jewelry Invoice to configure your shop details and certificate settings.
sections.faq:
Does it support GST?

Yes, it has comprehensive GST support for India and international tax engines.

Is the certificate generation included?

Yes, both invoice and certificate generation features are fully functional and included in this plugin.
